limitations: PARTIAL: 35 of 47 RAW files (acetylome runs: BioAcetyl_SILAC_NormNothing, Acetylome_H4, silac_ac_b, silac_ac_h4, acetyl_WT, acetyl_Hst4) not annotated - no deposited search output, no file-to-experiment or channel map in paper/supplementary; RAW headers carry no sample IDs
Fractionation method for NormExcess files inferred (no 'SCX' in names; same suffix scheme)
Strain BY4742 inferred from the stated parental WT background
Precursor tolerance from the paper's search (MaxQuant 1.2.6.20); the deposited search is MaxQuant 1.3.0.5 and does not record it
Enzyme specificity not independently verified from peptide C-termini (search was Lys-C specific)
reconcile flags Lys-C as unsupported by the PRIDE record text (one-line protocol); supported by deposited summary.txt and paper

Experiment numbering: the paper's Supplementary Data legends call biotin starvation Experiment 1, the reverse of Fig. 1a and the Supplementary Data 2 column headers (Exp.1 = excess, Exp.2 = depletion). The SDRF follows Fig. 1a and the column headers, which the deposited ratios confirm (NormExcess vs Exp.1 r = 0.94; NormMinus vs Exp.2 r = 0.93).
Scope: this SDRF covers the 12 SILAC proteome RAW files only (one deposited MaxQuant search); the 35 acetylome RAW files are excluded because no deposited file maps them to the paper's experiments.
